headline: GME Oman crude marker settles at $88.61 a barrel on 17 November
summary: The Gulf Mercantile Exchange's official Oman crude futures marker price was $88.61 a barrel on 17 November 2026, up $0.31 from five sessions earlier.

headline: Mongolia commissions 3,000 cubic metre fuel storage depot built by Mort Gobi Oil
summary: A new 3,000 cubic metre petroleum products depot built by Mort Gobi Oil LLC entered service in Mongolia on 13 November 2026, part of a state-backed push to expand fuel reserves.

source.name: Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources of Mongolia

cardImageAlt: Mongolia commissions 3,000 cubic metre fuel storage depot built by Mort Gobi Oil

headline: China cuts retail gasoline and diesel prices by 645 and 625 yuan a tonne from 12 November
summary: China's NDRC is lowering domestic gasoline and diesel prices by 645 yuan and 625 yuan per tonne respectively, effective from 24:00 on 12 November.

source.name: National Development and Reform Commission of China (NDRC)

cardImageAlt: China cuts retail gasoline and diesel prices by 645 and 625 yuan a tonne from 12 November

headline: GME Oman crude marker settles at $92.04 a barrel on 13 November, down on the week
summary: The Gulf Mercantile Exchange's official Oman crude futures marker price stood at $92.04 a barrel on 13 November, down $2.54 from a week earlier.
